results.title: Reptilians: They Walk Among Us
results.overview: They wear our faces, shape our destiny, and have waited through the ages for the perfect moment to rise, igniting a spiritual battle for our future.

results.title: Despicable Nights in Heaven
results.overview: When a married man's clandestine affair erupts into a grotesque confrontation in his apartment parking lot, his carefully constructed life begins to unravel in ways he never imagined. As he and his wife recount the same night through competing video-call confessions, a simple scandal transforms into a brutally funny and painfully intimate dissection of their marriage. Each revelation exposes not just betrayal, but the lies people tell themselves to preserve their identities, justify their choices, and survive intimacy. Blending biting humour with emotional precision, the film is a dark comedy about guilt, narcissism, and the uncomfortable truth that bringing everything into the open does not necessarily set anyone free.

results.title: Lastri: Arwah Kembang Desa
results.overview: Atmi is terrorized by the spirit of Lastri, a woman who committed suicide 30 years ago due to slander and cruel treatment from her village. Now, Lastri has returned to seek revenge, especially on Atmi and those who destroyed her life.

results.title: La promessa di Patrizio
results.overview: The real story of Patrizio Oliva, raised in an extended family in a difficult neighbourhood in Naples. After the loss of his brother Ciro, Patrizio decides to collect his legacy and fight for redeeming himself and his family.

results.title: Later.
results.overview: The invisible half of his brother's rap act, a 17-year-old beatmaker spends the night of the biggest show running errands. He steals an hour for his own music and gets caught for the one thing he did for himself.

results.title: ReLive
results.overview: A freak temporal anomaly erases her son from existence, a grieving mother is recruited for an impossible mission: travel back twenty years in her own timeline to a college hiking trip to kill the inventor of time travel to save her son.

results.title: The Caretaker Next Door
results.overview: After a conviction, an attorney is forced to lay low at her late grandmother's home to avoid retaliation. But when a caretaker's behavior takes a chilling turn, she realizes her headstrong ways have led her straight into the arms of a criminal.

results.title: 28 Summers
results.overview: When the men's Scottish football team qualified for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, it marked their return to the tournament for the first time since France 1998. This documentary follows their qualification journey.

results.title: Uka-Uka
results.overview: Battling boredom, a little boy gets trapped in the boot of a car. When he gets out, he's no longer the same.

results.title: СВОП
results.overview: The wedding has fallen through, and the bride heads from the registry office to the flea market to exchange her wedding dress for something better.

results.title: Doctor Doomscroll
results.overview: An isolated young woman fights to survive a demonic entity that preys on people who are stuck in a social media doomscroll. To make it out alive, she must confront the purposeless person she’s become—and the loved ones she’s pushed away.

results.title: And Something Else
results.overview: Neurosurgeon Gera is a good specialist, and patients love him, because he saves lives. But deep down he is unhappy, because he chose this path only because his late mother wanted him to. Hera's true passion is cinema, he always dreamed of making films. One day he finds out that he is terminally ill and he does not have long to live. Hera wants to spend the rest of his allotted time doing what he really loves: making movies.

results.title: Repay It in Blood
results.overview: Ten years after a bloody robbery, two sisters are done waiting for justice.

results.title: Billy Preston: That's the Way God Planned It
results.original_title: Billy Preston: That's the Way God Planned It
results.overview: With his signature gospel sound on the Hammond B3, Billy Preston doublehandedly elevated the greatest artists of his time – from the Beatles to the Rolling Stones, from Aretha Franklin to Eric Clapton, from Ray Charles to Barbra Streisand to Sly and the Family Stone. In our film, we explore Billy's career and influence on generations of musicians, as he scored several number one hits of his own and became one of the most sought-after musicians in the world. He did all of this as a soul divided -- by his deep roots in the church, in constant conflict with his identity as a gay Black man, searching for a family of his own that would accept him for who he was.

results.title: Licht, kein Licht
results.overview: A man who shot at people for no apparent reason, has been sentenced to prison. A young woman, a lab assistant, who is appointed as a juror in the case meets a sociologist who is working on a study of the penal system.

results.title: The Villain of Villains
results.overview: Skurkarnas skurk is about the 12-year-old and rebellious Stephanie who dreams of becoming a superhero just like her deceased mother, but fails miserably at the entrance exam to the Hero School. She may get a second chance if she infiltrates the School of Rogues and manages to recover a powerful artifact that was stolen. At the Villain School, her loyalty is tested, while her hunt leads her to the Villain of Villains. An evil creature that is a threat to the future existence of heroes and villains alike.

results.title: Nika's Room
results.overview: Jakob, a single father by day and sex worker by night, watches his teenage daughter Nika losing herself in the frenzy of nightlife. The more Nika rebels against him, the more desperately Jakob seeks comfort and validation from his client Martha.

results.title: Echoes of Tomorrow
results.overview: In four thought-provoking sci-fi stories, people confront altered memories, forbidden love, artificial lifetimes and extraordinary powers. As time, identity and reality begin to shift, each must decide what truly makes a life worth living.
